titleEn: Count the Number of Good Subarrays
title: 统计好子数组的数目
summary: 若子数组中相等元素下标对至少有 k 对，则为好子数组；统计所有连续好子数组数量。
insight: 右端加入值 x 时新增 frequency[x] 个相等对。窗口一旦达到 k 对，固定当前左端的所有更右结尾都合法，可加 n-right；随后移除左端并继续收缩寻找下一个合法左端。
pitfalls: 相等对数量可能很大要用 long
加入值前的频次就是新增对数
移除值后要减去剩余同值个数

solutions.title: 维护相等对数的滑动窗口
solutions.idea: 双指针枚举每个最小合法右端。
steps: while pairs>=k：answer+=n-right；移除 nums[left]，频次减一后 pairs-=新频次，left++

code.java: class Solution { public long countGood(int[] nums,int k){Map<Integer,Integer> frequency=new HashMap<>();long pairs=0,answer=0;int left=0;for(int right=0;right<nums.length;right++){int value=nums[right],count=frequency.getOrDefault(value,0);pairs+=count;frequency.put(value,count+1);while(pairs>=k){answer+=nums.length-right;int removed=nums[left++],remaining=frequency.get(removed)-1;frequency.put(removed,remaining);pairs-=remaining;}}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun countGood(nums:IntArray,k:Int):Long{val frequency=HashMap<Int,Int>();var pairs=0L;var answer=0L;var left=0;for(right in nums.indices){val value=nums[right];val count=frequency[value]?:0;pairs+=count;frequency[value]=count+1;while(pairs>=k){answer+=nums.size-right;val removed=nums[left++];val remaining=frequency[removed]!!-1;frequency[removed]=remaining;pairs-=remaining}};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:long long countGood(vector<int>& nums,int k){unordered_map<int,int> frequency;long long pairs=0,answer=0;int left=0;for(int right=0;right<(int)nums.size();++right){pairs+=frequency[nums[right]]++;while(pairs>=k){answer+=nums.size()-right;int removed=nums[left++];pairs-=--frequency[removed];}}return answer;} };
